# Overview

Sampling was conducted at four different sites (James Beach, College Creek,
Keck Environmental Field Lab Dock, Crim Dell)

# Goals

- Practice Sampling


## Materials
- Sampling Jars
- Petri Dishes
- Microscope

## Procedures

1. Rinse out sampling jar using a small amount of site water
2. Fill the sampling jar completely while submerged in water. Preferably collect
the sample near a rock (scraping biofilm from the rock surface) or near algae.
3. Pour contents of sampling jar into a petri dish
4. Observe contents underneath microscope

## Observations

No notable microbes were spotted in the samples collected :(
